storyCards.headline: Chase: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Giorgio Moroder's "Chase" reached #33 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #33 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Chase was released in 1979.
